newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to postpone 1998 local polls to avoid clash.
newsitem.headline: France to postpone 1998 local polls to avoid clash.

text.p: The French cabinet proposed on Wednesday to put off next year's local elections from March to June so that they do not clash with scheduled parliamentary and regional polls, government spokesman Alain Lamassoure said.
The proposal is to go before parliament and is expected to be accepted given the government's strong majority.
The government had decided previously that polls for the country's 22 regional councils would be held simultaneously with elections to the National Assembly in March 1998.
